# has notation system

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasNotationSystem`](gmeow-hasNotationSystem.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasNotationSystem>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A notation system used by a language — e.g. IPA for phonetic transcription, a stenographic system for shorthand. NON-FUNCTIONAL: a language may use many notation systems, and different standpoints may assign different notations ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) -> [`gmeow:NotationSystem`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystem.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the flat shortcut linking a language to a notation system it uses, when no role, period, standpoint, or confidence needs to be first-class — the unscoped half of the flat-first/reify-on-demand pair.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the use must carry a role, period, or competing standpoints; promote to a [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md) relator there. Avoid making it functional — a language legitimately uses many notations.

### How to use

- Assert language [`gmeow:hasNotationSystem`](gmeow-hasNotationSystem.md) notation for the simple case; when the binding needs scoping, mint a [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md) instead and read this flat link as its projection ([`gmeow:pairsWith`](gmeow-pairsWith.md)).
